repeatable_transitions.observation: The five initially nonzero 16-byte object records at 0xFFDD86+slot*0x10 become zero; 0xFFDD02 remains zero.
The same record area is reinitialized with five nonzero records; 0xFFDD02 remains zero.

observation: A full per-frame object-window series resumed from a saved state is byte-repeatable across independent runs and exposes deterministic transition boundaries without replaying setup.
limitation: The record clear/reinitialization is not sufficient to distinguish object spawn, game-state transition, or renderer reset; an independent gameplay selector and writer trace are required.
